messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads up — new HiringFlow connector pushed this morning triggered a field-translation mismatch. Several candidate imports lost `referral_source` and a subset of training-slot invites failed to schedule. Example incoming payload snippet:
```
{"candidate": {"name": "Alex Smith", "source": null, "tags": ["on-site"]}}
```
We expect `referral_source` but the vendor now sends `source`. Invite-worker returned 422s for a few jobs.

Samir Patel: ugh. do you have the failing job id and the exact error? can you paste the log excerpt so I can grep?

Maria Gomez: job 987654321. log excerpt: 
```
2024-06-12T06:13:02Z ERROR invite-worker job=987654321 status=422 details="missing recipient email" meta={mapping_error:true}
```
Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-4321

HiringBot: [alert] 21 events failed for connector `hiringflow-prod` in the last 30m. view: https://console.redwood.dev/connectors/hiringflow/errors

Lucy Chen: I rolled the connector change earlier — looks like the transform rule name changed during the vendor update (referral_source -> source). Quick hotfix suggestion: add a translation step in the import lambda to preserve legacy field names. Example patch:
```
# pseudo
if payload.get('source') and not payload.get('referral_source'):
    payload['referral_source'] = payload['source']
```
That should be safe for the short term.

Jordan Lee: for immediate remediation I executed a one-off backfill: `python tools/backfill_referrals.py --since 2024-06-11` — restored referral_source for 142 candidates and requeued invites for 96 that had pending scheduling.

Samir Patel: can we add a unit + integration test around the mapping change in CI? also add a schema validation step to the connector pipeline so ambiguous mappings fail fast. I'll own the PR and the test.

Maria Gomez: thanks — can ops watch the invite queue for the next 2h and flag any new 422s? @HiringBot please post aggregate updates every 15m. :facepalm:

HiringBot: ack — will post aggregated status every 15m and ping on new 422s. :thumbsup:

Lucy Chen: follow-up: created a short runbook at /docs/recruiting/connectors/hiringflow-mapping.md with steps for rollback, hotfix, and backfill commands. please review if you own escalation steps.

Jordan Lee: I added a blameless postmortem stub in the ticket describing the mapping regression and the training-slot scheduling race when referral_source is null.

Maria Gomez: closing the loop here — candidate impact minimal, operational cost ~2 dev-hours. monitoring window looks clean so marking resolved after one more hour of no new failures.
